building: Maurice G. Knoy Hall of Technology
reviewer: independent audit agent; did not build or edit Knoy R17

criteria.name: Identity and footprint
evidence: Purdue GIS target feature KNOY / FID 243 and project orthophoto overlay support identity and broad stepped footprint.
Approximate local geographic conversion and prior plan registration are not survey control.
findings: Exact structural wall-face residual and surveyed dimensions are not independently established in R17.

criteria.name: Placement, orientation, and scale
evidence: Manifest placement and local asset frame match prior review evidence.
R17 reports no placement or transform change.
findings: No new survey control or independent orientation measurement is supplied.

criteria.name: Height, floors, and roof
evidence: 2018 Purdue Gateway sheet labels L1-L4 floor-to-floor spacing.
Indiana 3DEP R8 assessment provides a broad, approximate roof-surface/ground comparison.
findings: L5 occupied-floor status, roof datum, penthouse/parapet dimensions, and exact rooftop-equipment placement remain unresolved.
GIS 48-ft attribute conflicts with other vertical cues.

criteria.name: Exterior and entrances
evidence: Purdue Archives building record 75 photo supports brick-heavy walls and narrow horizontal glazing ribbons on visible faces.
R17 changes L1-L4 ribbon height from 2.0 m to 1.4 m and adds brick infill; source evidence is qualitative and uncalibrated.
Entrance render shows recognizable brick, dark glazing, canopy and building lettering.
findings: Modeled glazing still forms broad, continuous, regular horizontal bands; the archival photo shows narrow, interrupted strips within large brick fields.
Photo does not establish 1.4 m measured band height, exact cadence, face assignment, or the same facade on every side.
Entrance text size, mounting and facade details remain qualitative.

criteria.name: Interior and circulation
evidence: Saved asset includes a first-floor trace, typical L2-L4 plan traces, illustrative doors, fixture proxies and stair runs.
Purdue 2018 typical-floor planning sheet provides layout evidence with documented hand-registration uncertainty.
findings: Plan is not an as-built survey; fixtures and some circulation features are interpretations.
Continuous accessible circulation across all levels is not verified.

criteria.name: Technical and evidence quality
evidence: Direct Blender 5.2.3 reopen succeeded; expected scene, asset collection and root are present.
R17 mesh and material assignment are present; no unpacked external image files were found.
R17 validation documents only two preexisting mesh edits, one added spandrel mesh, and unchanged preexisting transforms.

sources_reviewed: Purdue GIS footprint and project orthophoto evidence in audit/complete_knoy
decision: Below target; R17 is technically valid and makes a documented qualitative facade adjustment, but facade cadence and several vertical/interior dimensions remain unsupported or uncertain.
